# Prasun Shiwakoti

> Full-stack developer based in Kathmandu, Nepal. Builds web applications and
> AI agents, and the servers, databases and models that make them work. Most
> recently Buildor, a no-code website builder that 100+ people use. This is his
> personal site: a single page covering services, selected work, experience and
> contact details.

- **Role:** Full-Stack Web Developer at Laid&Lazy Pvt. Ltd.
- **Location:** Kathmandu, Nepal
- **Status:** taking freelance projects, works with clients anywhere
- **Email:** hello@prasunshiwakoti.com.np
- **Site:** https://prasunshiwakoti.com.np/

Most of his work is backend: the part of a product nobody sees, and the part
that decides whether the rest of it holds. Came to software through machine
learning and stayed for the engineering.

## What he builds for clients

- **Web applications:** full products with sign-in, dashboards, payments and an admin panel the client can run themselves.
- **AI agents and automation:** agents that research, write, sort or reply, connected to the tools a business already uses.
- **Machine learning features:** forecasts, recommendations and models that read text, built into an existing product.
- **APIs and backends:** connecting systems together, or taking over an unstable codebase and making it reliable.

## Selected work

- [Buildor](https://buildor.io): A platform that lets anyone build their own website without writing code. Architected and shipped at Laid&Lazy Pvt. Ltd.; more than 100 people run their sites on it. Django, React, PostgreSQL. 2025 to now.
- [AI Social-Media Automation](https://github.com/Prasun-Shiwakoti/Social-Media-Manager-AI): Writes on-brand posts with retrieval (RAG), schedules them, and scores how people feel in the replies, so one person can run several accounts. Django, React, RAG, LSTM. 2025.
- [Multi-Agent Research System](https://github.com/Prasun-Shiwakoti/Multi-Agent-Competitive-Intelligence-Research-System): Three AI agents research competitors. One gathers sources, one checks every claim, one writes the brief. Python, LLM agents. 2025.
- [News-Powered Market Analysis](https://github.com/Prasun-Shiwakoti/News-Powered-Stock-Market-Analysis): Combines the mood of the day's financial news with price history to forecast where stocks go next. Fusemachines AI Fellowship capstone. LSTM, XGBoost, Pandas. 2025.
- [Transformer From Scratch](https://github.com/Prasun-Shiwakoti/transformer-from-scratch): Attention, positional encoding and training written from first principles. PyTorch, NLP. 2024.
- [CoCo, AI Study Assistant](https://github.com/Prasun-Shiwakoti/CoCo): A study helper that learns where each student gets stuck and changes its explanations and practice questions to fit. Django, React, machine learning. 2024.
- [Heart-Disease Prediction API](https://github.com/Prasun-Shiwakoti/heart-disease-api): A web service that returns a heart-disease risk estimate from patient measurements in one request. FastAPI, scikit-learn. 2023.

## Experience

- **Full-Stack Web Developer, Laid&Lazy Pvt. Ltd.** (Sept 2025 to now): Architected and shipped Buildor, a no-code website builder with 100+ active users.
- **AI Fellow, Fusemachines** (May to Dec 2025): Fully funded six-month AI programme and Microdegree in AI. Shipped ML systems with Docker and automated deployment, and built data pipelines over 10,000+ records.
- **B.E. Computer Engineering, Kathmandu Engineering College** (2023 to now): Full scholarship, IOE rank 320. President of the KEC IT Club.
- **President, CS Club, Kathmandu Model College** (2020 to 2022): Grew club sign-ups by 25% and ran bootcamps on cybersecurity, Python and web development.
- **Hackathon winner, Provathon 2020** (CSIT Association of Nepal): A health-monitoring app that predicts cardiac arrest from live data.
